text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A little past the scheduled training time, I received an email from Ikuno Dictus.
However, its contents were rather mysterious—
choice_data_list: "Running late. Smartphone." ...What's that supposed to mean?
"Running late. Smartphone." ...What does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am so terribly sorry...!!
I dropped my smartphone earlier and it took me a while to find it—
choice_data_list: "Running late. Smartphone." ...Ah, that's what you meant.
So that's why it said "Running late. Smartphone."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I sent it written like that...!
It was already past the time when I collected them,
so I panicked... How embarrassing...!
choice_data_list: Be sure to come tell me beforehand in the future.
Please come tell me beforehand from now on, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how shaken she was, it was clear
she truly regretted her actions...
So I forgave her without scolding her any further.
